page.notes: Old-style numerals cIↄ Iↄ rendered as MDLXXXI is not used; kept as printed. Some words in the scan are uncertain (e.g. "Postquem", "successerit") and were copied as seen. The lower-right faint marginal text is a digitiser mark and was omitted.
